diagnosis: The endpoint queries AI model diagnostic inference results from BullMQ by jobId. It omits checking whether req.user.id is the ordering radiologist or treating physician for job.data.patientId, exposing diagnostic oncology reports and malignancy findings across patients.
exploit_request:
GET /api/radiology/scans/inference/job_mri_brain_90214 HTTP/1.1
Host: imaging.hospital.org
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_staff_jwt>
